flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/ManageTemplate/form/EditTemplateForm.tsx (SMS edit form, test-send block commented out), App.tsx (route edit-template/sms), hooks/useAPITemplate.tsx. ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsTemplateStore/OcmsTemplateStoreController (create/list/patch/render only), workflows/furnish/manualreview/controllers/ManualReviewController (Furnish send-sms). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no template test send
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'. Editing SMS text exists and works (textarea in the edit form, saved through templatestorepatch). The test send feature does not exist: the SMS edit form has no mobile number field and no test send button, the ComposeAction/onTestMap block in EditTemplateForm.tsx is commented out, and the template controller only has create, list, patch, render (render only fills placeholders for Furnish replies, it does not send). The send-sms endpoint in the Furnish module exists but requires a txnNo and records the SMS against a notice, so it is not a template test send and is not called from the template screen. The prod property is sms.enable=false (application-prod.properties:87); the real server value cannot verify from repo. No maintenance ticket concerns test send.
recommendation: Claim only the SMS text editing part. The mobile number field and test send are not built; ask URA to confirm whether they will be built or removed from scope

steps.step: Officer selects an SMS template and opens the edit screen
steps.detail: From the SMS tab, the View button navigates to /enotification/edit-template/sms with the row data (TemplateList.tsx:108-116; App.tsx:279-282) and EditTemplateForm type SMS shows Template Name, Remarks and the template content.

The SMS content is edited through TextAreaInput source templateContent (EditTemplateForm.tsx:146-153) and saved with POST templatestorepatch (useAPITemplate.tsx:104-110; OcmsTemplateStoreController.java:222-252).

steps.step: Officer enters a mobile number for the test in a field
steps.detail: The SMS edit form only contains Template Name, Create/Update date (readonly), Remarks and the template text (EditTemplateForm.tsx:108-153). There is no mobile number input; the block that used to hold the preview/test button (ComposeAction, onTestMap) is commented out (EditTemplateForm.tsx:49-71).

steps.step: The edited text arrives as a test SMS
steps.detail: The template controller only has create, list, patch and render (OcmsTemplateStoreController.java:28-33,176-204); render only fills notice placeholders and does not send. The Furnish /manual-review/send-sms endpoint requires a txnNo (ManualReviewController.java:466-468) and is not called from the template screen, so it is not a test send. The prod property is sms.enable=false (application-prod.properties:87); the server value cannot verify from repo, and delivery through the SMS gateway cannot verify from repo.
